idle.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D game sprite sheet. Use the attached SINGLE adult Oichi only as the character identity / costume / exact crisp ink-and-cel-shading reference. Keep the same slender adult proportions, white/red top, opaque red pleated battle skirt, slim black arm guards, tabi and red sandals. Keep ONE narrow long HIGH PONYTAIL tied at the crown with the SAME tiny red/gold clasp (no loose back hair, no big ribbons). The brown curved bow is strapped to her back and visible in EVERY frame, never in her hands. NO scene, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow or blur, no border/grid lines/letters. Genuinely transparent background. Exactly TWELVE SEPARATE FULL-BODY DRAWINGS arranged in FOUR columns and THREE rows, chronological row-major reading order. Each drawing must remain entirely inside its cell, including bow tips, ponytail and shoes. Each cell has generous 30-pixel blank margins, blank gutters separate every drawing. Maintain identical character anatomy, scale, lighting, palette and a consistent foot baseline within each row. Please render as a 1536x1536 square atlas with each upright body roughly 330 pixels tall; never shrink the whole figure merely to fit the weapon. Crisp fully opaque color interiors with a clean antialiased 1-pixel contour only. Preserve the reference's sharply defined facial features and fine ink detail at native resolution. ACTION: a seamless twelve-frame COMBAT IDLE breath cycle, facing screen right in the same slight three-quarter angle as the reference. Feet stay planted in one stable shoulder-width stance throughout. Redraw the moving arms, shoulders, chest breathing and ponytail in every frame, not duplicates translated or rotated. Frames 0-3 inhale gradually, upper torso lifts about 4 pixels, fingers close gently and forearms rise a little into guard. Frames4-5 reach the breath apex with subtle shoulder/arm adjustment. Frames6-9 gradually exhale, arms ease down slightly, hair tip follows with a delayed arc. Frames10-11 settle back toward frame0, ready to loop. Expression calm and alert, small natural movement only, no scratching, stretching or unrelated gestures. Nothing may touch the outside edge or adjacent cell. CRITICAL SPACING CORRECTION: The earlier attempt put bow tips against the feet in the preceding row. Reserve large empty strips between rows. Inside EACH of the 12 cells, the complete bow-to-sole silhouette must occupy only the CENTRAL 70 PERCENT of cell height. Center every full figure inside its own cell. At least 70 actual pixels of pure transparency between the feet of one row and the bow tips of the next row. At least 40 pixels margin to every outer image edge. No pixel from any figure touches another figure, all twelve must be separate islands. A standing woman's HEAD-TO-SOLE height should be about 270-290 pixels in the delivered square atlas, and the bow may add 25 pixels above her ponytail. Preserve all twelve distinct idle poses and the reference's narrow high ponytail. Do NOT zoom the figures to fill the canvas.

walk.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make one clean transparent 2D game sprite atlas of TWELVE chronological walk frames, 4 columns by 3 rows, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. FIRST INPUT is the adult Oichi identity, exact outfit, high ponytail, small red/gold hair tie and back bow reference; use its sharp hand-inked cel shaded artwork. SECOND INPUT is ONLY the leg/arm POSE SEQUENCE guide. Follow its alternating leg positions and lifted passing feet accurately while drawing anatomically natural adult proportions: red guide limbs represent the SAME nearer left limbs in all frames; blue limbs represent the SAME farther right limbs in all frames. Do NOT color the final limbs red or blue and do NOT include the stick figure, ground line, diagram or text. Replace each guide skeleton with the complete Oichi drawing, same consistent scale, crisp native detail. All face screen RIGHT. Frame0 left foot in front, frame3 left foot supports under hips while RIGHT foot swings past slightly raised, frame6 RIGHT foot in front with LEFT now behind, frame9 right foot supports while LEFT swings past slightly raised; frames1,2,4,5,7,8,10,11 are the natural connecting poses shown in the guide. The feet must alternately pass and exchange the foreground/background overlap; do not keep the same leg forward in all twelve images. Use natural opposite arm swing, ponytail secondary motion, bow strapped securely on back in EVERY frame. Keep the same modest red pleated battle skirt, white top, slim forearm guards, white tabi and red sandals. Full figure including both shoes, complete bow tips and ponytail in EVERY cell. Strict gutters: complete bow-to-shoe silhouette occupies 78% of each cell height, never touches another frame or outside canvas edge, at least 30 pixels clear empty gutter vertically and horizontally. Aim 1536x1536 pixels with human body at least280px tall per frame. Real RGBA transparency everywhere outside the sharp clean outline, no scenery, glow, blurry halo, floor shadow, labels or watermark.
